acceptance: For each governed path class above, uv run -- python _project/scripts/preflight_targets.py tests (the CLI pr-preflight uses) selects tests/unit/test_ledger_coverage.py. Each class is covered by a parametrized unit test, including a deleted workflow test file and a renamed script.
An unrelated path (for example benchbox/core/foo.py) does not select it; a unit test asserts this.
uv run -- pytest -q tests/unit/scripts/test_preflight_targets.py tests/unit/test_ledger_coverage.py passes. make comment-policy-check and the changelog check pass.

Decision gate: if preflight_targets has no hook for deleted-path selection and adding one changes behaviour for other guard tests, keep the change limited to the ledger test and record the wider gap as a deferral, not a silent widening.
context: Source: adversarial process review, 2026-11-07 (accepted finding B1 / tooling defect 4). The critic verified SOURCE_GUARD_TESTS has no ledger entry and that test-file paths skip guard tests.
description:
Problem. tests/unit/test_ledger_coverage.py requires every workflow, script, workflow, script or release test, and pre-commit hook to have a row in docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md. It is marked medium, so the fast tier skips it, and _project/scripts/preflight_targets.py has no entry that selects it. A PR adding .github/workflows/batch-loop-e2e.yml passed member checks, the fast tier and pr-preflight, then failed only at the final local review (#3999's predecessor). The gap is mode-independent: serial pr-preflight misses it too.

Change. In _project/scripts/preflight_targets.py, select tests/unit/test_ledger_coverage.py whenever a changed path matches what the ledger governs. Derive the set from the test's own globs: .github/workflows/*.yml, scripts/*.py, _project/scripts/**, tests/unit/workflows/**, tests/unit/scripts/**, tests/unit/release/**, tests/unit/test_auto_merge_*, tests/unit/test_release_*, .pre-commit-config.yaml and docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md. Include deleted and renamed test files: the test-file branch currently skips guard tests. Add unit tests in tests/unit/scripts/test_preflight_targets.py. One changelog.d fragment (internal).

Guardrails: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, or the batch targets for members); never edit the primary clone; stage paths explicitly; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or oracle gate; re-read each cited file on current origin/develop before editing, because line numbers drift. Do not change test_ledger_coverage.py's marker or assertions, and do not touch scripts/batch_integration.py.
